name: Noise removal
description: Noise removal (D88), export only: ffmpeg afftdn (FFT noise reduction) on the track, starting from the noise floor measured in the track media's loudness analysis (a fixed floor per track, −40 dBFS when unmeasured). The preview plays the track as recorded and marks it "applied on export".
author: Uncut

amount.description: 0 = light (6 dB of reduction) … 1 = strong (30 dB).
